chapters.text: Put your open tote next to the Hobo Bag and look at the details. They tell you which one to carry. Here they are, one pair at a time.
The sides. An open tote has one big space, so your keys sink. The Hobo Bag has a gold zip on each side: keys in one, phone in the other.

The inside. In a tote, everything ends up in one heap. Inside this bag, divided compartments keep the notebook, the wallet and the glasses apart.
So you walk out with everything in its place. Keys at the side, cards on your back, the bag on your shoulder, and nothing sliding around.

chapters.text: Myth: a big open tote is the easy bag. It holds everything, it goes with everything, so it must be the one for your busy days.
Fact: it holds everything in one heap. Your phone, your keys and your wallet all slide down into the same dark corner of the bag.
Now look inside the Hobo Bag. Divided compartments give every small thing its own place, so nothing sinks to the bottom.
And when your hands are full, the strap goes crossbody. Two straps come with the bag, so you wear it on the shoulder, as a handbag or across your body.
The gold zip on each side helps too: your keys on one side, your phone on the other, both one pull away.
So on the next busy day you walk out with the bag on your shoulder, both hands free, and every single thing exactly where you put it this morning.

chapters.text: Right now it is the tote. It goes on one shoulder, it stays on that shoulder, and it slips down every time you reach for something at the counter.
Switch to the Hobo Bag. It comes with two straps, so you can carry it as a handbag, wear it on the shoulder, or wear it crossbody.
Clip the long strap on, slide it across your body, and both of your hands are free for the coffee, the phone and the door. That is the whole switch.
And the soft, water-resistant leather looks expensive, so the same bag works from the morning errands to dinner.
The tote stays in the cupboard now. The bag on your shoulder has the look, the room inside and three ways to go, wherever the day takes you.
A handbag for the office, the shoulder for the shops, crossbody for the walk home: the same bag, all day long.
